text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Young Mistress...!\nUmm... Thanks for 
helping me out the other day."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is all ours. Thank you very 
much for staying at our inn today.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my leg is "just like 
this." Its recovery is progressing well, 
and walking longer than usual causes no 
issues at all now.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
A meal delivery robot, a party trick 
support arm, and other devices to boost 
facility efficiency. I've compiled a list 
of potentially useful inventions, but—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. Was it a nuisance bringing 
this up so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what ever are you saying? You are 
beyond welcome—and I am utterly thrilled, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
With this, the inn is sure to prosper and 
our guests will be completely satisfied. 
Bravo, our brilliant Doctor♪ You're a true 
genius♪

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're exaggerating! I don't even know 
if I can be of help yet...!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
First, we must conduct interviews with you 
staff members, run repeated tests, and 
observe trial operations—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
If we combine our strengths, we will 
surely achieve great results! Yes, we 
shall show everyone what we can do.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
And so—please, by all means, tell me all 
the juicy details♪
